characters.summary: Michigan J. Frog is a showman frog who sings and dances exclusively when unobserved by the general public, using theatrical performance as his primary medium.

mechanisms: Refusal to perform in front of crowds

weaknesses: Paralyzed into non-performance if watched by anyone other than his discoverer
limitations: Cannot perform miraculous acts of entertainment if multiple people are watching

sources.supports: Michigan J. Frog's singing, dancing, and behavioral traits.

feats.claim: Sang and danced to classic songs like Hello Ma Baby while wearing a top hat.

unknowns: Whether his singing has any offensive or combat application beyond psychological torment.

sources.supports: Mickey Mouse history, general capabilities, and personality.

feats.claim: Defeated a giant using cleverness, teamwork, and standard tools.
